messenger.label: Facebook Messenger
messenger.idHint: Found under your Facebook Page's About section.
messenger.tokenHint: Generated in the Meta app dashboard under Messenger → Settings. Stored encrypted and never shown again.
messenger.step1: In the Meta app dashboard, open Messenger → Settings → Webhooks.
messenger.step2: Paste the callback URL below and your verify token, then click Verify and Save.
messenger.step3: Subscribe the webhook to the messages field for this Page.

telegram.label: Telegram
telegram.idHint: Whatever you want to recognise this bot by — it must be unique.
telegram.tokenHint: The token BotFather gave you. Stored encrypted and never shown again.
telegram.step1: Copy the callback URL and secret token below.
telegram.step2: Call setWebhook on your bot with both values.
telegram.step3: Telegram will start delivering updates to that URL.

stripe.label: Stripe
stripe.idHint: Starts with acct_ — find it in Stripe under Settings → Business.
stripe.tokenHint: A restricted key with write access to Checkout Sessions is enough — it does not need full account access. Stored encrypted and never shown again.
stripe.secretHint: Starts with whsec_. Stripe shows it once when you add the endpoint below. Without it a payment cannot be proven genuine, so it is required.
stripe.step1: In Stripe, open Developers → Webhooks and add an endpoint at the URL below.
stripe.step2: Subscribe it to the checkout.session.completed event.
stripe.step3: Copy the signing secret Stripe shows you into the field above.
